title: Keep in weather
line: Storm night on the coastal data-keep. Lightning hits the building first. Title.

title: Awakening
line: On the table, a green laser finds him after the building strike. Optic wakes. One face: spherical rust head, warm green eye left, empty socket right, crooked copper plate.

title: Born beside absence
line: Cut from the picture. The dust twin stays out — not a reshoot.

title: The dead phone
line: Cracked phone ghosts August 2026 and WAKE PAIR — BAY 3. He sets it down carefully.

title: Rain on server glass
line: Palm on storm glass. Tower in the rain. One green point against the keep.

title: The unpulled lever
line: Red caged lever. He studies it. Leaves it.

title: Faces that are not his
line: Curling ID badges. None of them are him.

title: Well of light
line: Spiral stair. Storm light above. He starts climbing.

title: The sag
line: Midway, power dips. He sits with the rain leak. Stands because he can.

title: Threshold
line: Roof door. He steps through rear-on — face never turns to camera here. The keep ends here; the path begins.

title: Gold seam / the door
line: Cut from the picture. Not a reshoot. No gold roof — threshold goes to the path.

title: Down the cliff
line: Cut from the picture. Not a reshoot. No plunge — threshold to path, then weather.

title: Path that was never printed
line: Goat trail. Living color below. After the threshold — no gold roof, no cliff fall.

title: Rain school
line: Rain hits the crooked plate in the open. Weather, not a leak in stone.

title: Moss that is not rust
line: Soft living green. Finger. Recoil. Same finger back.

title: Tide pool looks back
line: A dish of sky. Something looks back. He does not keep the pool.

title: Wind in grass
line: Grass lays and stands. Movement with no motor.

title: The theft
line: Storm-petrel pecks a copper flake from the mismatched plate and flies.

title: The return
line: Nest ledge. Flake given back. Leftover returned.

title: Fox at ten yards
line: Three-legged coastal fox. Recognition across wet rock — not a rescue.

title: Shared lee
line: Squall. Same basalt lee for fox, robot, petrel above. Nobody saves anybody.

title: Absence rhymes
line: Empty socket and missing hind rhyme. Neither fills the other.

title: He does not go back
line: Keep small on the headland. He walks away.

title: Horizon
line: Fox at a chosen distance. Petrel a dark hyphen over the water. Horizon ahead. End card rustboy.ai.
